REVIEW FAIL (code): Deterministic archive date fallback — FR-003.
  WHERE: src/adapters/architecture/readiness.ts:154-174
  EXPECTED: Deduplicate by canonical directory and retain its greatest eligible archive fallback timestamp. Valid provenance still takes precedence.
  ACTUAL: directories.set(directory, time) overwrites the 12:00 fallback with midnight when readdir lists the 2026-11-18_legacy symlink after its target. Discovery selects the 10:00 report.
  FIX: Merge archive fallback timestamps independently of entry order before ranking reports. Keep the TR-004 regression in src/adapters/architecture/readiness.test.ts and its Phase 2 plan entry. If the review runner restores those files, recreate the test with 10:00 and 12:00 Markdown-only reports and enumerate the dated symlink to the 12:00 directory last.

DIAGNOSIS (iteration 2):
FIX: src/adapters/architecture/readiness.ts — In `readArchitectureReadiness`, replace `directories.set(directory, time)` with `directories.set(directory, Math.max(directories.get(directory) ?? time, time))`. Keep valid provenance ahead of the archive fallback.
FIX: src/adapters/architecture/readiness.test.ts — Extend the Markdown-only 10:00 and 12:00 test with a `2026-11-18_legacy` symlink to the 12:00 directory. Mock `node:fs/promises.readdir` to enumerate the symlink last and assert that discovery returns the canonical 12:00 `report.md` path. Record the case in Phase 2 TR-004 in `specs/045-workflow-governance/plan.md`. Run `specs/045-workflow-governance/gates/phase-02.sh` before and after the adapter change to verify failure and recovery.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Latest readable assessment report — FR-003.
  WHERE: src/adapters/architecture/readiness.ts:223-239
  EXPECTED: Skip a newer report containing an invalid UTF-8 byte and link the older readable report.
  ACTUAL: report.bytes.toString("utf8").trim() replaces byte 0xFF with U+FFFD. Discovery links 2026-11-18/report.md instead of 2026-11-17/report.md.
  FIX: Decode report bytes as UTF-8 with fatal error handling before checking for empty text. Retain the TR-004 regression that appends 0xFF to the newer report.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Unusable assessment metadata — FR-003.
  WHERE: src/adapters/architecture/readiness.ts:92-98,233-249,258-273
  EXPECTED: Link the dated Markdown report and return generatedAt, revision and scope as null when its companion JSON files contain invalid UTF-8.
  ACTUAL: JSON.parse(file.bytes.toString("utf8")) accepts replacement characters. Discovery returns the provenance timestamp, a U+FFFD revision and a scope that includes src/U+FFFD.
  FIX: Decode JSON bytes with fatal UTF-8 handling before parsing. Treat undecodable data as missing metadata and preserve archive fallback. Retain the TR-004 regression with 0xFF in the structured scope path and provenance revision. Keep hashing the architecture target as raw bytes.
